notes.title: HotFix 1.0.5
notes.content:
[b]The following changes have been made as of version 1.0.5:[/b]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed and issue with the leaderboard not being able to show the last entry in it.
[*] Fixed an audio issue with some sounds not being affected by the volume sliders
[/list]

[b]Game Additions:[/b]

Added some "motivational" quotes when dying to spice things up.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4
notes.content:
[b]The following changes have been made as of version 1.0.4:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed tutorial restart. Prior to this patch, if the player selects to restart after completing the tutorial within the same instance you would have to do the tutorial over and over again. Now this won't happen.
[*] Added Main Menu button for after the player dies in a run to connect the menus a little bit better.
[*] Fixed an issue when dying to the flood during a mantling animation. Prior to this change the player would get frozen each time the player would either restart or press play from the main menu and would have to restart the game. This is now fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]The following changes have been made as of version 1.0.3:[/b]

Added a tutorial on first playthrough. Basic controls on main menu were mostly a placeholder for a proper tutorial.  Also added a tutorial button on the main menu in case you wanted to refresh what was in it.

notes.title: HotFix 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]The following changes have been made as of version 1.0.1:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the keyboard and mouse settings disappearing when going back to the main menu
[*] Changed the color of the instructions to make them more readable for the various backgrounds
[*] Included controls when pausing the game in order to not lose progress. As well as make the controls more accessible.
[/list]
